name: Delivery to the Gnomes
summary: Kravel Koalbeard now has what he needs, and wants the Delicate Car Parts carried to Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats, who has waited a long time for them. Kravel admits he removed a little piece from Fizzle's order, and suggests you leave it unmentioned.

sections.title: A Piece Left Out
sections.body: Kravel Koalbeard tells you the parts are for Fizzle Brassbolts, who has been waiting a long time. Kravel confesses he took one little piece out of Fizzle's order, but feels sure it will not be missed. He calls the piece small and worthless, advises you not to bring it up, and asks you to trust him.

sections.title: Fizzle's Verdict
sections.body: Fizzle Brassbolts greets the parcel gladly: his hydro ratchets and repeater bolts have come at last, and they will do well enough.

faq.q: Who sends the parts to Fizzle Brassbolts?
aliases: who gives delivery to the gnomes
quest giver delivery to the gnomes
faq.answer: Kravel Koalbeard, at the Mirage Raceway. He asks you to carry the parts on to Fizzle Brassbolts.

faq.q: What did Kravel Koalbeard take from the package?
aliases: what is missing from the parts
faq.answer: Kravel says he removed one little piece from Fizzle's order, which he calls small and worthless, and he would rather you did not mention it to Fizzle.
To Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats, on the same flats as the Mirage Raceway, where Kravel Koalbeard is found.

aliases: previous quest delivery to the gnomes
what leads to delivery to the gnomes
faq.answer: This follows Parts for Kravel, in which you brought Kravel's package from Ratchet back to him.
